disease_name: Hypercholesterolaemia, Mixed dyslipidaemia, Cardiovascular disease, Hyperlipidemia following transplantation
indication: Treatment of primary (familial) hypercholesterolaemia or mixed dyslipidaemia, Reduction of mortality and the frequency of cardiovascular disease in patients with moderate to severe hypercholesterolemia and at high risk of a first cardiovascular event, Reduction of hyperlipidemia following transplantation
side_effects: muscle problems such as myalgia, myopathy, rhabdomyolysis, even fatal

disease_name: hypercholesterolaemia, mixed dyslipidemia, cardiovascular mortality and morbidity, post-transplant hyperlipidaemia
indication: treatment of primary hypercholesterolaemia or mixed dyslipidemia, reduction of cardiovascular mortality and morbidity in patients with moderate to severe hypercholesterolaemia and at high risk of a first cardiovascular event, reduction of cardiovascular mortality and morbidity in patients with a history of myocardial infarction or unstable angina pectoris and with normal or elevated cholesterol levels, reduction of post-transplant hyperlipidaemia in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy following solid organ transplantation
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: adults 10 mg - 40 mg, children not recommended, elderly no dosage adjustment needed unless predisposing risk factors, moderate or severe renal impairment or significant hepatic impairment 10 mg per day
mechanism_of_action: reduces cholesterol levels by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase enzyme in the liver
side_effects: muscle weakness, interstitial lung disease, diabetes mellitus, dermatomyositis, hepatotoxicity, myalgia, myopathy, rhabdomyolysis
unsuitable_population: children < 18 years, active liver disease, homozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia, elevated HDL cholesterol, concomitant therapy with fibrates is not recommended
